description: This file defines the Language class within the OpenCart system library, responsible for managing language data such as loading language files, retrieving, setting, and clearing language strings, and handling language-specific data structures.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Class for managing language strings and translation data within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the language object with a specific language code.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a namespace-to-directory mapping for loading language files from custom paths.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a language string by its key; returns the key itself if not found.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a language string for a specific key.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all language data, optionally filtered by a prefix.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all currently loaded language data.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads language strings from a specified file, with optional prefixing and language code override.
